newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas, Fr Telecom in Oda talks.
newsitem.headline: Havas, Fr Telecom in Oda talks.

text.p: France Telecom and media group Havas said in separate statements they were in talks on a buy and sell options for Oda telephone directory advertising, part of France Telecom.
"These rights could be exercised between January 1, 2000 and December 31, 2003," said the Havas statement, adding that the talks opening the possibility of buying Oda were at an "advanced stage".
